mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(memory_usage_percent, 2) as storageUsageRate, ROUND((cpu_usage_percent + gpu_usage_percent) / 2, 2) as computeUsageRate, ROUND(bandwidth_out_percent, 2) as outputTransportUsageRate, ROUND(bandwidth_in_percent, 2) as inputTransportUsageRate FROM node_metrics_history WHERE ip = #{ip} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(memory_usage_percent, 2) as storageUsageRate, ROUND((cpu_usage_percent + gpu_usage_percent) / 2, 2) as computeUsageRate, ROUND(bandwidth_out_percent, 2) as outputTransportUsageRate, ROUND(bandwidth_in_percent, 2) as inputTransportUsageRate FROM node_metrics_history WHERE node_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, node_id as nodeId, cpu_usage_core as cpuUsageCore, cpu_usage_percent as cpuUsagePercent, memory_usage_percent as memoryUsagePercent, memory_used_bytes as memoryUsedBytes, memory_freq_current_mhz as memoryFreqCurrentMhz, gpu_usage_percent as gpuUsagePercent, gpu_mem_used_bytes as gpuMemUsedBytes, bandwidth_in_bps as bandwidthInBps, bandwidth_out_bps as bandwidthOutBps, bandwidth_in_percent as bandwidthInPercent, bandwidth_out_percent as bandwidthOutPercent, net_rtt_avg_ms as netRttAvgMs, net_packet_loss_percent as netPacketLossPercent, created_at as createdAt FROM node_metrics_history WHERE node_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
